actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: misty escape
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} drops to 0 Hit Points outside its resting place, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed. While it has 0 Hit Points in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition until it regains any Hit Points, and it regains 1 Hit Point after spending 1 hour there.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: multiattack (vampire form only)
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .mmGraveStrike000]]{Grave Strike} attacks and uses [[/item .mmBite0000000000]]{Bite}.

actions.name: grave strike (vampire form only)
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of two hands.

actions.name: bite (bat or vampire form only)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=ngPzlEI5pVSdBv86]], one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=ngPzlEI5pVSdBv86]] within [[lookup @range.value activity=ngPzlEI5pVSdBv86]] feet [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=ngPzlEI5pVSdBv86]]. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains Hit Points equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmVampireSpawn00]{Vampire Spawn} under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control.

actions.name: charm
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCharmPerso], requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @abilities.cha.dc]]), and the duration is [[lookup @duration.value activity=fcRXSTOlFJShCl52]] hours. The &Reference[Charmed apply=false] target is a willing recipient of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[/item .mmBite0000000000]]{Bite}, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was Charmed by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

actions.name: shape-shift
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} isn't in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmBat00000000000]{bat} (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it. While in bat form, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and Speed, are unchanged. While in mist form, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. It has Resistance to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

actions.name: beguile
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommand000], requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @abilities.cha.dc]]). The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: deathless strike
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item .mmGraveStrike000]]{Grave Strike} attack.

actions.name: vampire weakness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has these weaknesses: Forbiddance. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant. Running Water. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. Stake to the Heart. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s heart while the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the Incapacitated condition. Sunlight. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
